lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hey Sam, Kendra here. How's your Monday going?

lines.text: Hi! Yes, now's good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Before we start, is there anything on your mind you want to make sure we get to today?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Actually, I had a question about swimming instead of walking.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Any problems this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Kind of down this week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So it's been a tough one.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Tell me how the band exercises went this week.

lines.text: It didn't happen this week.

lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.text: I just didn't feel like it.

lines.text: What did you notice on the days it went well?

lines.text: I don't know, honestly.

lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already told my family about my goal.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need this for my head too, not just my body.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Good question.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Could you do them while you watch TV?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sometimes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Can I share an idea?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're weighing it up, and that's fair.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone. It's just me and my husband now, so it's easier.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: This is about more than the band exercises. It's about getting your life back.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My kids is why I'm doing this. My daughter keeps reminding me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once you decide something, you follow through.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, I put a reminder on the fridge. My grandson thinks it's funny that I have a step counter.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I just forgot.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once the routine broke, it was easy to lose track.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're open to it. You just want it to fit your real life.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days. My doctor said the same thing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've got a plan in mind already.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I really want to feel like myself again.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you still have the band we gave you?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sometimes. I just forgot.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're not sure it's worth it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I mean, maybe after the summer.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So what would you like your goal to be for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe do the band exercises 5 times?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 7.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If it rains I'll walk in the hallway of my building.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Monday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, Kendra. Bye!

flags.reason: Same TV suggestion repeated verbatim after participant showed reluctance; repeated again at line 52.
Third repetition of the TV suggestion despite participant deferring change to after summer.
Participant's swimming question was never addressed or returned to.
'Kind of down' and later 'for my head' not explored for mood; no check on how she is feeling.
'Once you decide something, you follow through' pushes commitment without permission.

score.summary: Kendra set a concrete five-session goal with a confidence rating and a rain backup plan, and the participant generated most of the change talk herself. However, the coach repeated the same TV suggestion three times despite resistance, never addressed the swimming question or the participant's low mood, and did not summarize.
strengths: Line 59: Scaling question elicited confidence (7/10) and a concrete goal.
Line 62: Barrier planning for rain elicited a practical backup plan.
Line 14, 19, 22: Repeatedly affirmed the participant's autonomy over her plan.
coaching_tips: Line 29 and 52: Do not repeat the same suggestion after it was declined; ask what would work for her instead.
Line 6: Follow up on 'kind of down' with an open question about mood before moving to exercise goals.
Line 4: Return to the swimming question before the call ends, or schedule it for next time.
Line 35: Replace 'once you decide, you follow through' with a reflection of her commitment, e.g., 'You're committed to this for your kids.'
Line 54: Reflect her deferral to 'after the summer' (line 53) rather than repeating the autonomy phrase.
